title: Host Accounts Finance Note: Amount of the Superhost Travel Credit
content:
# Finance Note — The Superhost Travel Credit Amount (Host Accounts)

## Amount

The travel credit of a Host Accounts Superhost is the sum of its base amount and its stays bonus, rounded half up to the cent.

- **Base amount**: the travel credit amount of the account's host tier.
- **Stays bonus**: USD 1.00 for each completed stay recorded at the completing assessment (the Superhost assessment that completed the run).

## Whether a credit is earned

Whether the host earns the credit is decided by the tier that the decision recorded on the completing assessment gives the account, and only a tier whose travel credit amount is above USD 0.00 earns it.

On the quarterly assessment schedule a run is complete when the account's Superhost assessments recorded as met and dated within the 12 months before the credit number at least the tier's required consecutive met assessments; the credit for an incomplete run is USD 0.00. The 12 months hold the assessments dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the credit.

| Tier's travel credit amount above USD 0.00 | Met assessments in the 12 months at least the required number | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Base amount and stays bonus, summed and rounded |
| Yes | No | USD 0.00 |
| No | Yes or no | USD 0.00 |

## Worked amount (hypothetical inputs)

A Superhost account whose tier's travel credit amount is taken, for illustration, as USD 100.00 completes its run; the completing assessment recorded 14 completed stays.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Base amount | USD 100.00 |
| Stays bonus: 14 stays at USD 1.00 | USD 14.00 |
| Travel credit | **USD 114.00** |

If the same account had only three met assessments dated within the 12 months against a requirement of four, the run would be incomplete and the credit USD 0.00.
